subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost enforce a fixed 30-second WebSocket upgrade deadline, accepting that handshakes exceeding it will fail and reconnect?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but it changes shipped behavior from an unbounded wait to a fail-closed availability policy for slow servers or proxies.

options.title: Adopt the 30-second bound
options.body: Refresh and land the private timeout, matching existing runtime precedent without adding configuration.

options.title: Choose another fixed bound
options.body: Keep the implementation shape but use a maintainer-approved Mattermost-specific duration and rerun the proof.

options.title: Retain unbounded waits
options.body: Close the PR if compatibility with arbitrarily slow upgrades outweighs recovery from indefinitely stalled peers.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the private timeout, matching existing runtime precedent without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged reconnect implementation defines the retry and failure behavior activated by this deadline.
